verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show that Fastmail's own product source is published under an open license. The JMAP material describes an open protocol standard, not readable Fastmail source, so it is only adjacent. The 'Open source and standards' item is a bare page title with no content showing that the product's code is available or under which license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
